title: 일기 예보 읽기: 내일 우산이 필요해요?
objective: Read a short TV-style weather forecast for tomorrow and decide what to bring when you go out.
summary: Learners can find the weather, temperatures, chance of rain, and advice in a short forecast, then decide whether to bring an umbrella or a jacket.

task.title: FIND THE FORECAST DETAILS
task.line: Read the forecast carefully, then find the weather, temperatures, chance of rain, or advice that each question asks for.

words.meaning: (of the sky or weather) to be clear and sunny
words.exampleMeaning: The sky is clear today, so I feel good.

words.meaning: the lowest temperature of the day, usually in the morning
words.exampleMeaning: Tomorrow morning's low will be 5 degrees.

words.meaning: the highest temperature of the day, usually in the afternoon
words.exampleMeaning: Today's high will go up to 30 degrees.

words.meaning: the difference between the morning and afternoon temperatures
words.example: 요즘 일교차가 커서 감기에 걸리기 쉬워요.
words.exampleMeaning: The temperature changes a lot during the day these days, so it's easy to catch a cold.

words.meaning: a jacket or another layer you wear over your clothes
words.exampleMeaning: It's cold in the evening, so take a jacket.

words.meaning: chance of rain (or snow), given as a percentage
words.exampleMeaning: The chance of rain was 20%, so I didn't take an umbrella.

words.meaning: to make sure you bring something with you
words.exampleMeaning: I made sure I had my wallet and phone before I went out.

passage: 안녕하세요. 내일 날씨를 알려 드리겠습니다. 내일 서울은 오전에는 대체로 맑겠습니다. 하지만 오후부터 구름이 많아지고 흐려지겠습니다.
아침 최저 기온은 12도, 낮 최고 기온은 24도로 예상됩니다. 아침과 낮의 기온 차이가 12도나 돼서 일교차가 크겠습니다. 아침에 나가실 때는 얇은 겉옷을 준비하세요.
비 소식도 있습니다. 오후 늦게부터 밤사이에 비가 오겠습니다. 강수 확률은 오후에 60%, 밤에 80%입니다. 퇴근길에 비를 만날 수 있으니까 외출하실 때 꼭 우산을 챙기세요.
exercises: Read paragraph 1. What will the weather be like in Seoul tomorrow morning (오전)? Choose one: 맑음 / 흐림 / 비
Fill in the blanks with numbers from paragraph 2: 내일 아침 최저 기온은 ____도, 낮 최고 기온은 ____도예요.
Fill in the blank with a number from paragraph 3: 내일 밤 강수 확률은 ____%예요.
Choose the right word: 아침과 낮의 기온 차이가 커요. 그래서 (일교차 / 소나기)가 커요.
Read paragraphs 2 and 3. You leave home at 8 a.m. and come back at 8 p.m. tomorrow. Complete the sentence: 우산하고 ____ 챙겨야 해요.
